title: DeFiQuantHQ
tagline: Democratizing Wall Street: AI+Code HFT bots + tokenized stocks + cross-chain arbitrage, 24/7.
description:
-Authenticate real stock holdings via secure KYC and brokerage linking
-Mint tokenized stocks (TSLAx, AAPLx) with on-chain verification
-Trade tokens 24/7 across Ethereum and Moonbeam using 1inch Fusion+ bridge (atomic hashlock/timelock swaps)
-Sync real-time stock prices with Pyth pull oracles during market hours; dynamic pricing off-hours
-Browser IDE with natural-language prompts to generate, backtest, and deploy AI-driven HFT algorithms on 0G Compute
-Execute cross-chain arbitrage and limit orders via 1inch protocols with stock-sync hooks
-Tokenize algorithms as ERC-7857 INFTs: encrypted code, parameters, and performance on 0G Storage
-Trade INFTs in a decentralized marketplace, creating a creator-driven algorithm economy
-Fully decentralized stack—no backend, leveraging smart contracts and 0G services for storage, compute, AI, and data availability
how_its_made:
-Frontend built in Next.js with TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, and shadcn/ui
-Wallet integration via Wagmi and @rainbow-me/rainbowkit for seamless Ethereum and Moonbeam connectivity
-Solidity contracts on Ethereum and Moonbeam:
-AuthenticatedStockToken.sol for minting TSLAx/AAPLx post-verification
-Stock Fusion Bridge(and mirror on Moonbeam) extending 1inch Fusion+ for atomic hashlock/timelock swaps
-Stock Market Sync Hook integrating 1inch Limit Order Protocol with dynamic Pyth price checks
-Real-time price feeds from Pyth 
-Browser IDE using Monaco Editor 
-0G services wired in frontend lib:
      =>ZeroGStorageService for encrypted algorithm and INFT metadata storage
      =>ZeroGComputeService to deploy and run HFT algorithms globally
      =>ZeroGNLPService for prompt parsing and code suggestions
      =>ZeroGDAService for data availability proofs

-Cross-chain arbitrage engine with 1inch, pulling prices from Pyth and routing trades through 1inch API
-Intelligent NFTs with TradingAgentINFT storing encrypted code, learned parameters, and performance history
-No centralized backend—all state lives on smart contracts or 0G storage/compute; frontend directly invokes contract methods via ethers.js
-CI/CD  Vercel for frontend previews, ensuring testnet→mainnet parity

:-)Partner technologies
-1inch for best-in-class cross-chain routing+ limit-order hooks and extended it + 1inchApi
-Pyth Network for live, verifiable financial data
-0G Network for scalable, decentralized AI computation, iNFTs, smart contract deployment in iNFT and secure storage

This tech stack delivers a fully decentralized, always-on trading platform without any centralized backend.
